why: Not a single result recommends a NAS. The official docs and GitHub pages (authorities) only cover software install; the two listicles assume you already own a Synology; the rest are personal runbooks, compose files, or unreadable pages. No major reviewer tested NAS units for Paperless-ngx, and nobody states hardware requirements beyond "Docker and enough disk". A page that compares Docker-capable NAS models on CPU, RAM, bays and price, states what Paperless-ngx actually needs, and makes a pick would be the only direct answer in the set.
